text:
carla: Heads-up — opened a PR to switch the sidecar to token-projection + add a VPC egress exception for the onprem router. Need a quick security/privacy check before we merge in tomorrow's 11:00-12:00 PDT merge window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/7891

carla: Key changes: remove long-lived env creds from image, use projected SA token, and add a narrow egress rule for 10.10.3.0/24 -> onprem-router (10.20.30.5:443).

carla: Config snippet (kubectl manifest):
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
spec:
  containers:
    - name: sidecar
      env:
        - name: SERVICE_SA_SCOPE
          value: "projects/redwood/serviceAccounts/infra-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
        - name: USE_TOKEN_PROJECTION
          value: "true"
```

alice: @carla quick question — does the projected token still allow iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken? we need the minimal role set. also want to confirm secretmanager access removed.

carla: Yes — current plan grants only iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken. I removed SecretManager access from the role binding and stripped plaintext creds from the image. Diff linked in PR.

ben: sec-bot flagged an ENV in the Dockerfile on your branch earlier. re-scan after you remove it. :warning:

sec-bot: automated-scan: high - possible cleartext credential detected in infra/services/sidecar/Dockerfile:42. Please remove before merge.

carla: fixed that — replaced with reference to KMS_DEK and token projection. Example change in entrypoint: `export KMS_KEY=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/sidecar-dek` and we decrypt at runtime using projected token.

dave: From networking: I'll add the egress rule to allow 10.10.3.0/24 -> 10.20.30.5:443. NOTE: this traffic will be captured by VPC flow logs and may include headers/meta. Any concerns about PII or auth tokens in logs?

alice: privacy check: confirm that Authorization headers or tokens won't be logged. Please add a short dataflow note in the PR describing what fields are redacted and include the redaction config.

carla: added dataflow note and redaction config to the PR. snippet:
```text
# redaction rules
exclude_fields:
  - authorization
  - headers.Authorization
  - requestBody.tokens
```

alice: small nit — add a unit/integration test that asserts no AUTH header is written to application logs (we have tests/logging/helpers.LOG_CAPTURE). If you can't get it in before merge, add a TODO in the PR and we'll require the test in the follow-up.

carla: I can add the test today. Requesting 1x security approval + 1x privacy approval. @alice can you sign off for privacy after the test? @ben can you re-run sec scan once I push the test?

ben: will re-run after you push. currently lgtm pending scan pass.

sec-bot: automated-scan: passing on commit 4598765490.

dave: Network side: scheduling egress rule apply at 11:05 PDT tomorrow, canary traffic at 11:10, full rollout at 11:20. I'll be watching logs and will escalate if anomalous patterns appear.

alice: Privacy approved (pending the unit test added as discussed). Leaving a note to remove the TODO after merge.

ben: Security approval ✅ — scan green and SA scope minimized.

carla: Thanks team — merging in the 11:00 slot. I'll post any anomalies to #incidents and follow up with a brief postmortem if needed. :rocket:
